title: Concept: Shell command executed through std::system in cpp — review required
description: In cpp, std::system runs a shell command. The call inherits the environment and the working directory, and the shell re-parses the string, so quoting is the only barrier. C++ code frequently builds the string with operator+ from request fields, which makes the injection direct.
applicability: cpp native services and tools that call external programs.
risk: Shell injection with process privileges; HIGH severity.
